fields.v: No single SDD approach. Five control-plane families: prompt-native packs (Superpowers, SKILL.md bundles, prompt collections); prompt-modular shells (Cline v3, KiloCode); runtime-governed shells (Claude Code, OpenCode, Qwen Code, Gemini CLI, Warp); host-mediated/coordinator forms (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Windsurf, Kiro); durable workflow runtimes (LangGraph, Vertex AI ADK, OpenAI Codex). Kiro noted for 'specs as source-of-truth control artefacts'. Versions not stated (evidence as of early/mid 2026)

Page numbers are PDF pages (printed journal pages 46-64). Extends the authors' earlier overview [23]. Mentions a 'companion repository' with a worked example but gives no URL in text. Table 3 coding matrix columns partly jumbled by pdftotext; ratings rebuilt from row order (to check against PDF). Reporting inconsistencies: the coding matrix is called 'Table 2' in the text (p 8) but is Table 3 (Table 2 is the rubric); the conclusion places the benchmark interpretation problem in 'Section 4' but it is Section 5 (p 15); the matrix is dated 'early 2026' (p 9) but Table 4 'mid-2026' (p 10); the abstract says the memory comparison covers write-policy visibility and traceability, but Table 5 has only artefact- and procedural-memory columns (p 1, 11). Claims partly supported by cited vendor reports and preprints; no empirical data
